verdict: A tidy visual base with inconsistent spacing and too many type sizes.

findings.title: Eleven font sizes in use
findings.issue: The design tokens list eleven distinct sizes, several only 1px apart.
findings.fix: Reduce to a six-step scale and map every style to it.

findings.title: Spacing values are ad hoc
findings.issue: Margins range over 23 values with no pattern.
findings.impact_text: Rhythm feels uneven from section to section.
findings.fix: Adopt an 8px scale and replace one-off values.

strengths: Contrast passes AA on body text
